### New
- The app updates itself. About 15 seconds after launch, and once a day while it runs, it checks for a new release. When there is one, the widget shows a short message and the tray menu offers "Update to version x.y.z": it downloads the installer, updates in place and starts the widget again, keeping your settings. "Check for updates" in the tray checks right away. Updates are only installed when their signature matches the key built into the app.
- The portable exe can't update itself, so its menu item opens the release page instead.

**Updating from 0.5.7 or earlier:** those versions don't have the updater, so install this one by hand over the old one. From now on it updates itself.
